Good service completes good dining experience
Aug 2018
Based on the reviews we read, we have decided to dine at Bushido since it is a walking distance back to the hotel that I stayed in.

We arrived outside the restaurant and a staff welcomed us by opening the taxi door. Well, it was definitely a good gesture that I appreciate. I could be anybody just alighting and go somewhere else.

The staff greeted us with a smile and seated us next to the window. The restaurant wasn't full with about four occupied tables. 

Free wifi was provided and the password was imprinted on the table saving me the hassle of asking the staff.

The pictorial menus were presented to us in English language. It was quite a breeze compared to some places due to language barrier. The servers tried their best in taking our orders correctly. I noticed the staff that are more experienced or understand better English was observing the server while orders were taken. They did not hesitate to step in to help and ensure the order taking was done correctly. 

The staff repeated our orders to make sure they didn’t miss out anything. 

Drinks were served first while we waited for our food. 

Sashimi was surprisingly fresh. The clam dish was nicely cooked. We also ordered grilled seafood and was given a choice to grill it ourself or they grill it in the kitchen. The dish was nicely cooked when served. Grilled pork belly was delicious.

The Vietnamese coffee jelly was pleasantly nice in cleansing the palette. 

During our meal, the staff were very observant. The bowl for our empty shells was changed before it was filled. Empty dishes were cleared timely to ensure the table was not cluttered. Hot green tea was topped up when they noticed it was empty.

The total bill was inexpensive and value for money.

It is obvious that the serving staff did their best to ensure that customers’ dining experience is worth their visit, despite their handicap in conversing with foreign customers. 

Kudos to the staff for making my visit to the restaurant a pleasant one. Will visit Bushido Restaurant one more time before I end my holiday in Vietnam as a closure if time permits.

I am quite frustrated by this experience and I would strongly recommend not visiting here.
